数据组件

数据表单 AsamForm

使用类型化 schema 与控件注册表组合字段、依赖和数据来源。

数据表单 ​

使用类型化 schema 与控件注册表组合字段、依赖和数据来源。

基础用法 ​

示例通过 createAsamSchema() 绑定模型与 asamFormControls，使用字段插槽和 actions 插槽。模型更新由 v-model 返回新的对象。

类型化 Schema 与插槽

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamForm v-model="model" :schema="schema" @search="submitted = $event">
		<template #field-keyword="{ value, update }">
			<AsamInput
				:model-value="value"
				placeholder="输入关键词"
				@update:model-value="update(String($event))"
			/>
		</template>
		<template #actions="{ search, reset }">
			<button type="button" @click="search">查询</button>
			<button type="button" @click="reset">重置</button>
		</template>
	</AsamForm>
	<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
	<pre>{{ submitted }}</pre>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamFormBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamForm, AsamInput, asamFormControls, createAsamSchema } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Model {
	keyword: string;
}

const model = ref<Model>({ keyword: '' });
const submitted = ref<Model>({ keyword: '' });
const builder = createAsamSchema<Model>()(asamFormControls);
const schema = [
	builder.field({ field: 'keyword', component: 'Input', label: '关键词', defaultValue: () => '' })
];
</script>
vue
<template>
	<AsamForm v-model="model" :schema="schema" @search="submitted = $event">
		<template #field-keyword="{ value, update }">
			<AsamInput
				:model-value="value"
				placeholder="输入关键词"
				@update:model-value="update(String($event))"
			/>
		</template>
		<template #actions="{ search, reset }">
			<button type="button" @click="search">查询</button>
			<button type="button" @click="reset">重置</button>
		</template>
	</AsamForm>
	<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
	<pre>{{ submitted }}</pre>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamFormBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamForm, AsamInput, asamFormControls, createAsamSchema } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const model = ref({ keyword: '' });
const submitted = ref({ keyword: '' });
const builder = createAsamSchema()(asamFormControls);
const schema = [
	builder.field({ field: 'keyword', component: 'Input', label: '关键词', defaultValue: () => '' })
];
</script>

Schema 与控件覆盖 ​

schema 配合 registry 使用；createAsamSchema 的 field 校验字段名、模型类型和对应控件。componentProps 不能接管 modelValue、来源属性或值策略保留字段。数据来源在 dataSource 与 resolveDataSource 中二选一；静态与异步来源须符合控件注册的 sourceKinds。

内置控件已自动注册。asamFormControls 提供给 createAsamSchema 做类型检查，不作为 registry prop 再传一次；registry 只接收由 defineAsamControl 创建的新 custom: 名称，不能覆盖内置控件。

表单标量日期与时间 ​

注册表的 DatePicker、TimePicker 和 TimeSelect 使用 string|null 协议。Form 自有适配器为前两者显式传入 YYYY-MM-DD、HH:mm:ss；componentProps.valueFormat 可指定其他字符串格式。原生清空结果在 Form 适配器中映射为 null，reset 使用字段 defaultValue 或 emptyValue。基础日期组件仍保留原生默认值、模型联合与清空行为；需要 Date、数组或范围模型时使用范围控件、字段插槽或自定义注册控件。

表单标量日期、时间与空值

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<AsamForm
		ref="form"
		v-model="model"
		:schema="schema"
		@reset="resetModel = $event"
	/>
	<button type="button" @click="form?.resetFields()">重置日期字段</button>
	<pre data-testid="scalar-date-model">{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</pre>
	<pre>{{ JSON.stringify(resetModel) }}</pre>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamForm, asamFormControls, createAsamSchema } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamFormExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamFormScalarDateTimeDemo' });
interface Model {
	date: string | null;
	time: string | null;
	timeSelect: string | null;
}
const model = ref<Model>({ date: '2026-10-08', time: '09:30:00', timeSelect: '09:30' });
const resetModel = ref<Model>();
const form = ref<AsamFormExpose<Model>>();
const builder = createAsamSchema<Model>()(asamFormControls);
const schema = [
	builder.field({
		field: 'date',
		component: 'DatePicker',
		label: '日期',
		componentProps: { clearable: true, placeholder: '表单日期' }
	}),
	builder.field({
		field: 'time',
		component: 'TimePicker',
		label: '时间',
		componentProps: { clearable: true, placeholder: '表单时间' }
	}),
	builder.field({
		field: 'timeSelect',
		component: 'TimeSelect',
		label: '时间选项',
		componentProps: { clearable: true, placeholder: '表单时间选项' }
	})
];
</script>
vue
<template>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<AsamForm
		ref="form"
		v-model="model"
		:schema="schema"
		@reset="resetModel = $event"
	/>
	<button type="button" @click="form?.resetFields()">重置日期字段</button>
	<pre data-testid="scalar-date-model">{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</pre>
	<pre>{{ JSON.stringify(resetModel) }}</pre>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamForm, asamFormControls, createAsamSchema } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamFormScalarDateTimeDemo' });
const model = ref({ date: '2026-10-08', time: '09:30:00', timeSelect: '09:30' });
const resetModel = ref();
const form = ref();
const builder = createAsamSchema()(asamFormControls);
const schema = [
	builder.field({
		field: 'date',
		component: 'DatePicker',
		label: '日期',
		componentProps: { clearable: true, placeholder: '表单日期' }
	}),
	builder.field({
		field: 'time',
		component: 'TimePicker',
		label: '时间',
		componentProps: { clearable: true, placeholder: '表单时间' }
	}),
	builder.field({
		field: 'timeSelect',
		component: 'TimeSelect',
		label: '时间选项',
		componentProps: { clearable: true, placeholder: '表单时间选项' }
	})
];
</script>

依赖与隐藏规则 ​

dependsOn 声明前置字段；resolveDataSource 从只读模型派生来源。onDependencyChange 和 onHide 分别使用 retain 或 clear，按实际规则保留或清除模型。hidden、disabled 可以是布尔值或只读模型函数；回调不得修改模型。动态数据控件的暂停和旧请求取消由控件及表单生命周期协作处理。

插槽与实例 ​

field-字段名 插槽提供 field、model、value、update 和 updateValue；使用更新函数写回对应字段。actions 提供 search 与 reset 回调，二者返回 void；search/reset 事件携带当前模型，使用事件监听读取模型。append 用于追加内容，validate 使用基础表单事件。setFieldsValue 接收 Partial，validate、clearValidate、resetFields 与基础表单实例契约关联。fields 兼容入口不作为类型化 schema 的新示例。

默认与布局 ​

本组件设置 inline=true、labelWidth=auto、showSearch=true、showReset=true、labelMode=visible，searchText 为“搜 索”、resetText 为“重置”。基础表单能力通过显式公开类型关联；model 由 modelValue 接管。

本站继承关系 ​

  • AsamBaseForm：适用的基础展示、交互与公开 API。

本页数据来源、模型、事件和实例的覆盖规则优先；本站链接不扩大本组件公开契约。尺寸使用基础组件的 ASAM 尺寸规则，示例使用 default。

依赖来源、隐藏与重置 ​

完整示例按地区派生成员 API 来源，在地区变化时清除旧成员；隐藏备注时清除备注并暂停其验证，重新显示后恢复 required 规则。使用 setFieldsValue 事务更新模型，validate 的拒绝由调用方处理，读取 fields/getField 并通过 setInitialValues + resetFields 设置重置目标。defaultValue 工厂用于 schema 字段的默认重置值；actions 的事件用于读取提交模型。接口只在演示内部运行。

同一示例可切换 onDependencyChange 与 onHide 的 retain／clear 策略：retain 保留当前模型，clear 使用注册控件的空值。hidden 和 disabled 分别提供布尔及只读模型函数形式；禁用控件保留当前值，隐藏字段暂停验证，重新显示后恢复规则。固定成员来源通过 dataSource 传入预建 API 来源，依赖成员来源通过 resolveDataSource 派生，两者互斥；清空地区时 resolver 返回 undefined，暂停请求并保留过期选项快照，恢复地区后重新加载并可再次选择。追加长度规则与 required 同时生效；清空显式初始值再重置时，备注使用 defaultValue 工厂的非空默认值，随后隐藏并 clear 仍清为空值。

成员字段也可独立切换必填、枚举规则、布尔／函数隐藏和禁用；固定来源与派生来源使用相同字段策略。隐藏后暂停成员验证，重新显示恢复必填；禁用保留值并继续验证，不能用禁用跳过必填。非空成员默认值仅用于 schema 重置，隐藏清值仍使用 Select 的 null 空值。固定来源下改变地区时，依赖 retain／clear 控制当前成员值，来源仍保持原预建 API。

成员显示配置可切换 schema 的 label 与 componentProps.placeholder，并恢复原标签和占位文案。成员仍使用注册的 RemoteSelect，选择只更新 member 字段，保留地区及备注；读取成员配置可确认 getField('member') 与 fields 中的同一公开字段上下文、原生 prop 和字段总数。

固定来源分支禁止再传 resolveDataSource，派生来源分支禁止再传 dataSource；类型检查会拒绝这两种组合。绕过类型后同时传入两者时，Form 在挂载控件或发起请求前显示互斥配置错误，并保留原模型。只传固定来源或只传 resolver 均可正常建立字段。

依赖来源、隐藏清除与校验重置

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section>
		<fieldset>
			<legend>字段依赖策略</legend>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="retainDependency" type="checkbox">保留依赖值</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="retainHidden" type="checkbox">保留隐藏值</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="hideNote" type="checkbox">隐藏备注开关</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="disableNote" type="checkbox">禁用备注开关</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="defaultMemo" type="checkbox">非空默认备注</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="extraRule" type="checkbox">追加长度规则</label>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanHidden = true">布尔隐藏策略</button>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanHidden = false">函数隐藏策略</button>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanDisabled = true">布尔禁用策略</button>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanDisabled = false">函数禁用策略</button>
			<button type="button" @click="fixedSourceMode = true">固定成员来源</button>
			<button type="button" @click="fixedSourceMode = false">依赖成员来源</button>
			<button type="button" @click="form?.setFieldsValue({ region: 'east' })">
				切换东区
			</button>
			<button type="button" @click="resetSchemaDefaults">使用schema默认值重置</button>
			<button type="button" @click="form?.setFieldsValue({ region: '' })">
				清空地区来源
			</button>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="requiredMember" type="checkbox">成员必填</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="extraMemberRule" type="checkbox">成员枚举规则</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="hideMember" type="checkbox">隐藏成员开关</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="disableMember" type="checkbox">禁用成员开关</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="retainMemberHide" type="checkbox">保留隐藏成员</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="defaultMember" type="checkbox">非空默认成员</label>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanMemberHidden = true">成员布尔隐藏</button>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanMemberHidden = false">成员函数隐藏</button>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanMemberDisabled = true">成员布尔禁用</button>
			<button type="button" @click="booleanMemberDisabled = false">成员函数禁用</button>

				清空成员值

				设置西区成员值
			</button>
			<button type="button" @click="form?.setFieldsValue({ region: 'hide-member' })">
				成员隐藏地区
			</button>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="alternateMemberPresentation" type="checkbox">成员显示配置</label>
			<button type="button" @click="inspectMember">读取成员配置</button>
		</fieldset>
		<AsamForm
			ref="form"
			v-model="model"
			:schema="schema"
			:inline="false"
			size="default"
			:show-search="false"
			:show-reset="false"
			@search="submitted = $event"
			@reset="resetCount++"
			@validate="validateCount++"
		>
			<template #actions="{ search, reset }">
				<button type="button" @click="search">提交模型</button>
				<button type="button" @click="reset">重置模型</button>
			</template>

		<button type="button" @click="form?.clearValidate()">清除校验</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.setFieldsValue({ region: 'hide' })">隐藏备注</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.setFieldsValue({ region: 'west' })">切换西区</button>

		</p>

		<pre data-testid="form-submitted">{{ JSON.stringify(submitted) }}</pre>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamFormDependenciesDemo' });
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamForm, asamFormControls, createAsamSchema, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamFormExpose, AsamValue, AsamOptionsSource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Model {
	region: string;
	note: string;
	member: AsamValue | null;
}
interface Member {
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
const model = ref<Model>({ region: 'east', note: '', member: null });
const submitted = ref<Model | null>(null);
const form = ref<AsamFormExpose<Model>>();
const retainDependency = ref(false);
const retainHidden = ref(false);
const hideNote = ref(false);
const disableNote = ref(false);
const booleanHidden = ref(false);
const booleanDisabled = ref(true);
const fixedSourceMode = ref(false);
const defaultMemo = ref(false);
const extraRule = ref(false);
const alternateMemberPresentation = ref(false);
const memberContext = ref({
	present: false,
	propMatches: false,
	listContainsField: false,
	count: 0
});
const requiredMember = ref(false);
const extraMemberRule = ref(false);
const hideMember = ref(false);
const disableMember = ref(false);
const retainMemberHide = ref(true);
const defaultMember = ref(false);
const booleanMemberHidden = ref(false);
const booleanMemberDisabled = ref(true);
const validation = ref('未执行');
const validateCount = ref(0);
const resetCount = ref(0);
const fields = ref<{ count: number; hasRegion: boolean }>({ count: 0, hasRegion: false });
const sources = new Map<string, AsamOptionsSource<string, Member, 'api'>>();
function sourceFor(region: string) {
	if (!region) return undefined;
	return ensureSource(region);
}
function ensureSource(region: string) {
	let source = sources.get(region);
	if (!source) {
		source = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>().api({
			api: async (_params: undefined, context) => {
				await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 100));
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return [{ label: region + ' Alpha', value: region + '-alpha' }];
			},
			params: undefined,
			transform: (rows) => rows,
			fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
		});
		sources.set(region, source);
	}
	return source;
}
const builder = createAsamSchema<Model>()(asamFormControls);
const schema = computed(() => {
	const hidden = hideNote.value;
	const disabled = disableNote.value;
	const memo = defaultMemo.value;
	const memberHidden = hideMember.value;
	const memberDisabled = disableMember.value;
	const memberDefault = defaultMember.value;
	const memberLabel = alternateMemberPresentation.value ? '地区成员' : '成员';
	const memberPlaceholder = alternateMemberPresentation.value ? '请选择地区成员' : '选择地区成员';

	return [
		builder.field({
			field: 'region',
			component: 'Input',
			label: '地区',
			required: true,
			defaultValue: () => 'east'
		}),
		builder.field({
			field: 'note',
			component: 'Input',
			label: '备注',
			required: true,
			rules: extraRule.value ? [{ min: 2, message: '至少两个字符', trigger: 'blur' }] : [],
			dependsOn: ['region'],
			hidden: booleanHidden.value ? hidden : (current) => hidden || current.region === 'hide',
			disabled: booleanDisabled.value
				? disabled
				: (current) => disabled && current.region === 'west',
			onHide: retainHidden.value ? 'retain' : 'clear',
			defaultValue: () => (memo ? '工厂默认备注' : '')
		}),
		fixedSourceMode.value
			? builder.field({
					field: 'member',
					component: 'RemoteSelect',
					label: memberLabel,
					required: requiredMember.value,
					rules: extraMemberRule.value
						? [
								{
									type: 'enum',
									enum: ['east-alpha'],
									message: '仅东区成员',
									trigger: 'change'
								}
							]
						: [],
					hidden: booleanMemberHidden.value
						? memberHidden
						: (current) => memberHidden || current.region === 'hide-member',
					disabled: booleanMemberDisabled.value
						? memberDisabled
						: (current) => memberDisabled && current.region === 'west',
					onHide: retainMemberHide.value ? 'retain' : 'clear',
					dependsOn: ['region'],
					dataSource: ensureSource('fixed'),
					onDependencyChange: retainDependency.value ? 'retain' : 'clear',
					componentProps: { teleported: false, placeholder: memberPlaceholder },
					defaultValue: () => (memberDefault ? 'east-alpha' : null)
				})
			: builder.field({
					field: 'member',
					component: 'RemoteSelect',
					label: memberLabel,
					required: requiredMember.value,
					rules: extraMemberRule.value
						? [
								{
									type: 'enum',
									enum: ['east-alpha'],
									message: '仅东区成员',
									trigger: 'change'
								}
							]
						: [],
					hidden: booleanMemberHidden.value
						? memberHidden
						: (current) => memberHidden || current.region === 'hide-member',
					disabled: booleanMemberDisabled.value
						? memberDisabled
						: (current) => memberDisabled && current.region === 'west',
					onHide: retainMemberHide.value ? 'retain' : 'clear',
					dependsOn: ['region'],
					resolveDataSource: (current) => sourceFor(current.region),
					onDependencyChange: retainDependency.value ? 'retain' : 'clear',
					componentProps: { teleported: false, placeholder: memberPlaceholder },
					defaultValue: () => (memberDefault ? 'east-alpha' : null)
				})
	];
});
async function validate() {
	try {
		validation.value = (await form.value?.validate()) ? '有效' : '无效';
	} catch {
		validation.value = '无效';
	}
}
function resetInitial() {
	form.value?.setInitialValues({ region: 'west', note: '初始备注', member: null });
	form.value?.resetFields();
}
function resetSchemaDefaults() {
	form.value?.setInitialValues({});
	form.value?.resetFields();
}
function inspectMember() {
	const field = form.value?.getField('member');
	memberContext.value = {
		present: !!field,
		propMatches: field?.prop === 'member',
		listContainsField: !!field && (form.value?.fields ?? []).includes(field),
		count: form.value?.fields.length ?? 0
	};
}
function inspect() {
	fields.value = {
		count: form.value?.fields.length ?? 0,
		hasRegion: !!form.value?.getField('region')
	};
}
</script>

布局、自定义注册和兼容字段 ​

完整示例用 custom:status 注册真正只发出 yes/no 的包装控件，componentProps.caption 为必填；宽 Input 不能代替窄枚举控件。布局按钮切换 inline、labelPosition、labelMode 和两档表单尺寸，sr-only 保留可访问名称。校验使用基础 rules 与 scrollToError，拒绝由调用方处理，validate 事件保留字段及结果。append 插槽放置字段后的内容。

兼容按钮在独立实例之间切换 schema 和 fields：旧 fields 使用 key/type/options，仍支持输入、选择、验证及重置；它不提供 createAsamSchema 的字段和控件双向类型检查，新表单继续使用 schema。两种模式均由同一 v-model 管理真实模型，不同时提供 schema 和 fields。

完整布局场景记录四个公开事件：update:modelValue、search、reset 保留具体模型快照，validate 保留字段、布尔结果和消息。default 无scope且位于生成字段之前；append 无scope；actions 提供零参数 search/reset，在示例中显式调用，不把 MouseEvent 当作字段参数。schema 和兼容 fields 都可检查上述行为。

顶层配置在 schema／registry 与兼容 fields 两种方式下共同演示 v-model、inline、数字／文本 labelWidth、visible／sr-only labelMode 和 large／big／default／small 四档尺寸；尺寸由表单传给未单独设尺寸的输入控件。勾选使用内置操作后移除 actions 插槽，showSearch／showReset 独立控制两个按钮，searchText／resetText 切换默认与自定义文案；查询在配置有效时直接发出当前模型，不自动验证字段；需要验证时由调用方显式调用 validate。重置恢复初始模型。取消内置操作后恢复原 actions 插槽。

布局、兼容字段与自定义窄枚举

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<button type="button" @click="nativeComposition = 'options-state-contract'">打开完整选项状态示例</button>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<button type="button" @click="nativeComposition = undefined">关闭完整选项状态示例</button>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<section v-if="nativeComposition === 'options-state-contract'" data-testid="options-state-contract-case">
		<button type="button" :disabled="optionsStateContractBusy" @click="runOptionsStateContract">验证远程字典状态与生命周期</button>
		<div ref="optionsStateInjectionTarget" />
		<pre data-testid="options-state-contract-result">{{ JSON.stringify(optionsStateContractResult) }}</pre>
	</section>

	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<button type="button" @click="nativeComposition = 'source-contract'">打开完整来源工厂示例</button>

	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<section v-if="nativeComposition === 'source-contract'" data-testid="source-contract-case">

		<pre data-testid="source-contract-result">{{ JSON.stringify(sourceContractResult) }}</pre>

					:label="'Domain' + index"

					:rules="{ required: true, message: 'domain can not be null', trigger: 'blur' }"
					:data-domain-key="domain.key"
				>
					<AsamInput
						:model-value="domain.value"
						@update:model-value="updateDynamicDomain(domain.key, $event)"
					/>
					<button
						type="button"
						:aria-label="'Delete Domain' + index"
						@click="removeDynamicDomain(domain.key)"
					>
						Delete
					</button>
				</AsamFormItem>
			</AsamForm>
			<button type="button" @click="validateDynamic(false)">动态无回调提交</button>
			<button type="button" @click="validateDynamic(true)">动态回调提交</button>
			<button type="button" @click="addDynamicDomain">New domain</button>
			<button type="button" @click="dynamicForm?.resetFields()">动态重置</button>
			<button type="button" @click="readDynamicFields">读取动态字段状态</button>
			<pre data-testid="dynamic-state">{{
				JSON.stringify({ model: dynamicModel, events: dynamicEvents })
			}}</pre>
			<pre data-testid="dynamic-settlement">{{ JSON.stringify(dynamicSettlement) }}</pre>
			<pre data-testid="dynamic-callback">{{ JSON.stringify(dynamicCallback) }}</pre>
			<pre data-testid="dynamic-fields">{{ JSON.stringify(dynamicFields) }}</pre>
		</section>
		<button type="button" @click="compositionCase = 'alignment'">打开标签对齐组合示例</button>
		<button type="button" @click="compositionCase = 'accessibility'">
			打开可访问性组合示例
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="compositionCase = undefined">关闭对齐可访问性示例</button>
		<section v-if="compositionCase === 'alignment'" data-testid="alignment-case">
			<AsamForm
				v-model="alignmentModel"
				:inline="false"
				:show-search="false"
				:show-reset="false"
				label-width="auto"
				:label-position="alignmentFormPosition"
			>
				<AsamFormItem
					label="Form Align"
					label-position="right"
					data-testid="alignment-form-control"
				>
					<div role="radiogroup" aria-label="label position">
						<!-- prettier-ignore -->
						<label
							v-for="position in alignmentFormPositions"
							:key="position"
						><input
							v-model="alignmentFormPosition"
							type="radio"
							:value="position"
						>{{ position }}</label>
					</div>
				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem
					label="Form Item Align"
					label-position="right"
					data-testid="alignment-item-control"
				>
					<div role="radiogroup" aria-label="item label position">
						<!-- prettier-ignore -->
						<label
							v-for="position in alignmentItemPositions"
							:key="position"
						><input
							v-model="alignmentItemPosition"
							type="radio"
							:value="position"
						>{{ position || 'Empty' }}</label>
					</div>
				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem
					v-for="field in alignmentFields"
					:key="field.key"
					:label="field.label"
					:label-position="alignmentItemPosition"
					:data-testid="'alignment-' + field.key"
				>
					<AsamInput
						:model-value="alignmentModel[field.key]"
						@update:model-value="updateAlignment(field.key, $event)"
					/>
				</AsamFormItem>
			</AsamForm>
			<pre data-testid="alignment-state">{{
				JSON.stringify({
					model: alignmentModel,
					formPosition: alignmentFormPosition,
					itemPosition: alignmentItemPosition
				})
			}}</pre>
		</section>
		<section v-if="compositionCase === 'accessibility'" data-testid="accessibility-case">
			<p>
				Full Name 标签自动关联单个输入；Your Information 标识多输入组，每个输入仍有独立的
				aria-label。placeholder 不替代可访问名称。
			</p>
			<AsamForm
				v-model="accessibilityModel"
				:inline="false"
				:show-search="false"
				:show-reset="false"
				label-position="left"
				label-width="auto"
			>
				<AsamFormItem label="Full Name" data-testid="accessibility-single">
					<AsamInput
						:model-value="accessibilityModel.fullName"
						@update:model-value="updateAccessibility('fullName', $event)"
					/>
				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem label="Your Information" data-testid="accessibility-group">
					<AsamInput
						:model-value="accessibilityModel.firstName"
						aria-label="First Name"
						placeholder="First Name"
						@update:model-value="updateAccessibility('firstName', $event)"
					/>
					<AsamInput
						:model-value="accessibilityModel.lastName"
						aria-label="Last Name"
						placeholder="Last Name"
						@update:model-value="updateAccessibility('lastName', $event)"
					/>
				</AsamFormItem>
			</AsamForm>
			<pre data-testid="accessibility-state">{{ JSON.stringify(accessibilityModel) }}</pre>
		</section>
		<button type="button" @click="openValidationCase('custom')">打开自定义校验示例</button>
		<button type="button" @click="openValidationCase('number')">打开数字校验示例</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validationCase = undefined">关闭校验示例</button>
		<section v-if="validationCase" data-testid="validation-case">
			<AsamForm
				:key="validationCase"
				ref="validationForm"
				v-model="validationModel"
				:show-search="false"
				:show-reset="false"
				:rules="validationRules"
				:validate-on-rule-change="false"
				status-icon
				@validate="onValidationCaseEvent"
			>
				<AsamFormItem v-if="validationCase === 'custom'" label="密码" prop="password">
					<AsamPassword
						:model-value="validationModel.password"
						@update:model-value="updateValidationText('password', $event)"
					/>
				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem v-if="validationCase === 'custom'" label="确认密码" prop="confirm">
					<AsamPassword
						:model-value="validationModel.confirm"
						@update:model-value="updateValidationText('confirm', $event)"
					/>
				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem label="年龄" prop="age">
					<AsamInput
						:model-value="validationModel.age"
						@update:model-value="updateValidationAge"
					/>
				</AsamFormItem>
			</AsamForm>
			<button type="button" @click="validateCase(false)">示例无回调提交</button>
			<button type="button" @click="validateCase(true)">示例回调提交</button>
			<button type="button" @click="validationForm?.resetFields()">示例重置</button>
			<button type="button" @click="readValidationCase">读取示例字段状态</button>
			<pre data-testid="validation-case-state">{{
				JSON.stringify({
					kind: validationCase,
					model: validationModel,
					pending: ageValidationPending,
					events: validationEvents,
					crossValidation: confirmRevalidation
				})
			}}</pre>
			<pre data-testid="validation-case-settlement">{{
				JSON.stringify(validationCaseSettlement)
			}}</pre>
			<pre data-testid="validation-case-callback">{{
				JSON.stringify(validationCaseCallback)
			}}</pre>
			<pre data-testid="validation-case-fields">{{
				JSON.stringify(validationCaseFields)
			}}</pre>
		</section>
		<button type="button" @click="validateNativeSubset('profile.nickname')">
			原生校验嵌套字符串字段
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validateNativeSubset([['profile', 'nickname']])">
			原生校验嵌套分段数组字段
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validateNativeNestedCallback">原生嵌套回调校验</button>
		<button
			type="button"
			@click="
				form?.setFieldsValue({
					name: 'Mixed live',
					status: 'yes',
					profile: { nickname: 'Nested live' }
				})
			"
		>
			准备混合当前模型
		</button>
		<button
			type="button"
			@click="
				form?.setInitialValues({
					name: 'Mixed initial',
					profile: { nickname: 'Mixed nested A' }
				})
			"
		>
			混合姓名嵌套基线
		</button>
		<button
			type="button"
			@click="
				form?.setInitialValues({ status: 'yes', profile: { nickname: 'Mixed nested B' } })
			"
		>
			混合状态嵌套基线
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.setInitialValues({ name: 'Omitted nested' })">
			省略嵌套初始值
		</button>
		<button
			type="button"
			@click="form?.setInitialValues({ name: '', status: 'no', profile: { nickname: '' } })"
		>
			恢复完整嵌套基线
		</button>
		<fieldset>
			<legend>原生嵌套 FormItem</legend>
			<button type="button" @click="enableNativeItem">启用嵌套字段</button>
			<button type="button" @click="disableNativeItem">关闭嵌套字段</button>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemArrayPath" type="checkbox">使用分段字段路径</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemLabelSlot" type="checkbox">使用字段标签插槽</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemErrorSlot" type="checkbox">使用字段错误插槽</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemRulesEnabled" type="checkbox">使用字段规则</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemRequired" type="checkbox">字段显式必填</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemArrayRules" type="checkbox">使用数组和多触发器规则</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemHideMessage" type="checkbox">隐藏字段校验消息</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemInlineMessage" type="checkbox">字段行内校验消息</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemExternalError" type="checkbox">字段外部错误</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="itemForcedSuccess" type="checkbox">字段强制成功状态</label>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelPosition = 'left'">字段左侧标签</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelPosition = 'right'">字段右侧标签</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelPosition = 'top'">字段顶部标签</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelWidth = 'auto'">字段自动标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelWidth = 120">字段恢复标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelText = '昵称'">字段短标签</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelText = '这是较长的嵌套昵称标签'">
				字段长标签
			</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelText = '嵌套昵称'">字段恢复标签文本</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemRequiredMode = 'explicit'">字段显式必填属性</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemRequiredMode = 'undefined'">
				字段未定义必填属性
			</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemRequiredMode = 'omitted'">字段省略必填属性</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelWidth = 168">字段数字标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemLabelWidth = '200px'">字段文本标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemSize = 'large'">字段 large 尺寸</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemSize = 'big'">字段 big 尺寸</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemSize = 'default'">字段 default 尺寸</button>
			<button type="button" @click="itemSize = 'small'">字段 small 尺寸</button>
			<button type="button" @click="validateNativeItem('blur')">字段 blur 校验</button>
			<button type="button" @click="validateNativeItem('change')">字段 change 校验</button>
			<button type="button" @click="validateNativeItem('blur', true)">字段回调校验</button>
			<button type="button" @click="nativeItem?.clearValidate()">字段清除校验</button>
			<button type="button" @click="nativeItem?.setInitialValue('Item initial')">
				字段设置初始值
			</button>
			<button type="button" @click="nativeItem?.resetField()">字段恢复初始值</button>
			<button
				type="button"
				@click="form?.setInitialValues({ profile: { nickname: 'Form nested initial' } })"
			>
				表单设置嵌套初始值
			</button>
			<button type="button" @click="form?.resetFields(['profile.nickname'])">
				表单重置嵌套字段
			</button>
			<button type="button" @click="readNativeItem">读取字段公开状态</button>
		</fieldset>
		<button type="button" @click="readNativeFields">读取原生表单字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validateNativeSubset('name')">原生校验字符串字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validateNativeSubset(['name', 'status'])">
			原生校验数组字段
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validateNativeSubset()">原生校验全部字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validateNativeSubsetCallback">原生字段回调校验</button>
		<button
			type="button"
			@click="form?.setInitialValues({ name: 'Native initial', status: 'yes' })"
		>
			设置原生初始值
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.setInitialValues({ name: '', status: 'no' })">
			恢复原生初始值
		</button>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<label><input v-model="singleNativeRule" type="checkbox">使用单条原生规则</label>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<label><input v-model="validateOnRuleChange" type="checkbox">自动校验规则变更</label>
		<button type="button" @click="labelPosition = 'left'">原生左侧标签</button>
		<button type="button" @click="labelPosition = 'right'">原生右侧标签</button>
		<button type="button" @click="labelPosition = 'top'">原生顶部标签</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.clearValidate(['name', 'status'])">
			数组清除字段校验
		</button>
		<fieldset>
			<legend>原生表单显示配置</legend>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="labelSuffixEnabled" type="checkbox">显示标签后缀</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="hideRequiredAsterisk" type="checkbox">隐藏必填星号</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="asteriskRight" type="checkbox">星号放在右侧</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="hideMessages" type="checkbox">隐藏校验消息</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="inlineMessage" type="checkbox">行内校验消息</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="statusIcon" type="checkbox">显示校验状态图标</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="disabled" type="checkbox">禁用原生表单控件</label>
		</fieldset>
		<fieldset>
			<legend>表单顶层配置</legend>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="builtinActions" type="checkbox">使用内置操作</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="showSearch" type="checkbox">显示查询按钮</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="showReset" type="checkbox">显示重置按钮</label>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<label><input v-model="customActionText" type="checkbox">自定义操作文案</label>
			<button type="button" @click="labelWidth = 'auto'">表单自动标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="labelWidth = 168">数字标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="labelWidth = '200px'">文本标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="labelWidth = 120">恢复标签宽度</button>
			<button type="button" @click="size = 'large'">表单 large 尺寸</button>
			<button type="button" @click="size = 'big'">表单 big 尺寸</button>
			<button type="button" @click="size = 'default'">表单 default 尺寸</button>
			<button type="button" @click="size = 'small'">表单 small 尺寸</button>
		</fieldset>
		<button type="button" @click="legacy = !legacy">切换兼容字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="inline = !inline">切换行内布局</button>
		<button type="button" @click="labelPosition = labelPosition === 'top' ? 'right' : 'top'">
			切换标签位置
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="labelMode = labelMode === 'visible' ? 'sr-only' : 'visible'">
			切换可访问标签
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="size = size === 'default' ? 'big' : 'default'">
			切换表单尺寸
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validate">校验全部字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="validateWithCallback">用回调校验全部字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.clearValidate('name')">清除姓名校验</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.clearValidate()">清除全部校验</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.setFieldsValue({ name: 'Patched' })">
			只更新姓名模型
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.resetFields()">重置字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.resetFields(['name'])">只重置姓名字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.resetFields('name')">用字符串重置姓名字段</button>
		<button
			type="button"
			@click="
				omitScrollError = false;
				scrollToError = !scrollToError;
			"
		>
			切换校验自动滚动
		</button>
		<button type="button" @click="omitScrollError = true">省略校验自动滚动</button>
		<button type="button" @click="scrollMode = 'true'">使用 true 滚动参数</button>
		<button type="button" @click="scrollMode = 'false'">使用 false 滚动参数</button>
		<button type="button" @click="scrollMode = 'object'">使用对象滚动参数</button>
		<button type="button" @click="scrollMode = 'omitted'">省略滚动参数</button>
		<button type="button" @click="scrollMode = 'undefined'">传入 undefined 滚动参数</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.scrollToField('name')">滚动到姓名字段</button>
		<button type="button" @click="form?.scrollToField('missing')">滚动到不存在字段</button>
		<div data-testid="layout-scroll-host" style="max-height: 280px; overflow-y: auto">
			<p style="min-height: 320px">滚动区域从这里开始，表单字段位于下方。</p>
			<AsamForm
				:key="legacy ? 'legacy' : 'schema'"
				ref="form"
				v-model="model"
				:inline="inline"
				:label-position="labelPosition"
				:label-mode="labelMode"
				:label-width="labelWidth"
				:size="size"
				:rules="nativeRules"
				:validate-on-rule-change="validateOnRuleChange"
				:label-suffix="labelSuffixEnabled ? '：' : ''"
				:hide-required-asterisk="hideRequiredAsterisk"
				:require-asterisk-position="asteriskRight ? 'right' : 'left'"
				:show-message="!hideMessages"
				:inline-message="inlineMessage"
				:status-icon="statusIcon"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:show-search="showSearch"
				:show-reset="showReset"
				v-bind="{
					...(legacy ? { fields } : { schema, registry }),
					...(customActionText ? { searchText: '筛选成员', resetText: '恢复成员' } : {}),
					...nativeScrollBinding
				}"
				@validate="onValidate"
				@update:model-value="recordModel('update:modelValue', $event)"
				@search="recordModel('search', $event)"
				@reset="recordModel('reset', $event)"
			>
				<template #default>
					<p data-testid="layout-form-default">默认内容位于字段之前，不替代生成字段。</p>
					<AsamFormItem
						v-if="nativeItemEnabled"
						ref="nativeItem"
						data-testid="layout-native-item"
						:prop="itemArrayPath ? ['profile', 'nickname'] : 'profile.nickname'"
						:label="itemLabelText"
						:label-position="itemLabelPosition"
						:label-width="itemLabelWidth"
						v-bind="{
							...itemRequiredBinding,
							...(itemRules === undefined ? {} : { rules: itemRules })
						}"
						:error="itemExternalError ? '外部昵称错误' : ''"
						:show-message="!itemHideMessage"
						:inline-message="itemInlineMessage"
						:size="itemSize"
						for="layout-native-item-input"
						:validate-status="itemForcedSuccess ? 'success' : ''"
					>
						<!-- prettier-ignore -->
						<template
							v-if="itemLabelSlot"
							#label="{ label }"
						>
							<span data-testid="layout-native-item-label">{{ label }}插槽</span>
						</template>
						<AsamInput
							id="layout-native-item-input"
							:model-value="model.profile?.nickname ?? ''"
							@update:model-value="updateNickname"
						/>
						<!-- prettier-ignore -->
						<template
							v-if="itemErrorSlot"
							#error="{ error }"
						>
							<span data-testid="layout-native-item-error">{{
								error
							}}</span>
						</template>
						<template #help>嵌套字段帮助</template>
					</AsamFormItem>
				</template>
				<template v-if="!builtinActions" #actions="{ search, reset }">
					<button type="button" @click="search()">插槽查询</button>
					<button type="button" @click="reset()">插槽重置</button>
				</template>
				<template #append>
					<p data-testid="layout-form-append">追加内容与字段使用同一表单实例。</p>
				</template>
			</AsamForm>
		</div>
		<pre data-testid="layout-form-native-fields">{{
			JSON.stringify(nativeFieldsSnapshot)
		}}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="layout-form-native-subset">{{
			JSON.stringify(nativeSubsetSettlement)
		}}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="layout-form-native-subset-callback">{{
			JSON.stringify(nativeSubsetCallback)
		}}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="layout-native-item-state">{{
			JSON.stringify({
				...nativeItemSnapshot,
				requiredMode: itemRequiredMode,

const controlSourceRegistration = ref<{

		expected: string[];
		actual: readonly ControlSourceKey[];

		externalAfter: string[];

function registerControlSourceOrders() {
	const registered = makeControlSourceOrders().map((order) => {
		const expected = [...order],

				component: asamFormControls.Select.component,
				emptyValue: () => null,
				sourceKinds: order

		Reflect.apply(Array.prototype.pop, order, []);

	for (const sourceKinds of [['api', 'api'], ['unknown'], { api: true }]) {

		object,

	>({
		component: asamFormControls.RemoteSelect.component,
		emptyValue: () => null,
		sourceKinds: ['api']

		(sourceKinds) =>
			defineAsamControl<
				AsamValue | null,
				object,

		rejected,
		empty: empty.sourceKinds,
		singleton: singleton.sourceKinds,
		pairs
	};
}

const runtimeContractResult = ref<{ phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[]>([]);
function runRuntimeContract() {
	const observations: { phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];
	const record = (phase: string, state: Record<string, unknown>) =>
		observations.push({ phase, state });
	const configFailure = (action: () => unknown) => {
		try {
			action();
			throw Error('Expected configuration rejection');
		} catch (cause) {
			if (!(cause instanceof AsamDataFailure)) throw cause;
			return { kind: cause.kind, message: cause.message };
		}
	};
	const emptyRuntime: AsamDataRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime();
	record('runtime-default-construction', {
		scope: emptyRuntime.scope,
		epoch: emptyRuntime.epoch,
		providerAbsent: emptyRuntime.provider === undefined,
		frozen: Object.isFrozen(emptyRuntime)
	});
	const hostCause = {},
		failureCause = {},
		calls = { request: 0, hook: 0, notify: 0 };
	let recursive = false;
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		request: async () => {
			calls.request++;
			return [];
		},
		isErrorNotified: (cause) => {
			calls.hook++;
			return cause === hostCause;
		},
		onError: (error) => {
			calls.notify++;
			recursive = runtime.reportError(error, errorContext) === error;
		}
	};
	const runtime: AsamDataRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: 'runtime-a' });
	runtime.install(provider);
	runtime.install(provider);
	const replacement = configFailure(() => runtime.install({}));
	record('runtime-late-install-same-identity-and-replacement-guard', {
		providerIdentity: runtime.provider === provider,
		scope: runtime.scope,
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		requestCalls: calls.request,
		replacement
	});
	const a = runtime.createContext(),
		b = runtime.createContext(),
		foreign = { ...a };
	runtime.release(foreign);
	record('runtime-context-identity-readonly-and-foreign-release', {
		ids: [a.requestId, b.requestId],
		scopes: [a.scope, b.scope],
		epochs: [a.epoch, b.epoch],
		frozen: [Object.isFrozen(a), Object.isFrozen(b)],
		current: [runtime.isCurrent(a), runtime.isCurrent(b), runtime.isCurrent(foreign)],
		aborted: [a.signal.aborted, b.signal.aborted],
		runtimeFrozen: Object.isFrozen(runtime)
	});
	runtime.release(a);
	runtime.release(a);
	record('runtime-idempotent-release', {
		current: [runtime.isCurrent(a), runtime.isCurrent(b)],
		aborted: [a.signal.aborted, b.signal.aborted],
		epoch: runtime.epoch
	});
	const events: string[] = [],
		unsubscribeA = runtime.onInvalidate(() => events.push('A')),
		unsubscribeB = runtime.onInvalidate(() => events.push('B'));
	runtime.setScope('runtime-a');
	record('runtime-same-scope-no-invalidation', {
		scope: runtime.scope,
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		current: runtime.isCurrent(b),
		events: [...events]
	});
	runtime.setScope('runtime-b');
	record('runtime-scope-change-synchronous-abort-and-all-listeners', {
		scope: runtime.scope,
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		current: runtime.isCurrent(b),
		aborted: b.signal.aborted,
		events: [...events]
	});
	const c = runtime.createContext();
	runtime.invalidate();
	record('runtime-explicit-invalidation', {
		context: { id: c.requestId, scope: c.scope, epoch: c.epoch },
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		current: runtime.isCurrent(c),
		aborted: c.signal.aborted,
		events: [...events]
	});
	unsubscribeB();
	unsubscribeB();
	const d = runtime.createContext();
	runtime.invalidate();
	record('runtime-unsubscribe-one-idempotently', {
		id: d.requestId,
		contextEpoch: d.epoch,
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		aborted: d.signal.aborted,
		current: runtime.isCurrent(d),
		events: [...events]
	});
	unsubscribeA();
	runtime.invalidate();
	record('runtime-unsubscribe-all', { epoch: runtime.epoch, events: [...events] });
	const errorContext = runtime.createContext(),
		original = new AsamDataFailure('request', 'owned runtime request failure', failureCause),
		reported = runtime.reportError(original, errorContext);
	record('runtime-normal-error-notification-recursion-and-dedup', {
		id: errorContext.requestId,
		scope: errorContext.scope,
		epoch: errorContext.epoch,
		kind: reported.kind,
		message: reported.message,
		causePreserved: reported.cause === failureCause,
		requestId: reported.requestId,
		notified: reported.notified,
		frozen: Object.isFrozen(reported),
		sameInput: runtime.reportError(original, errorContext) === reported,
		sameOutput: runtime.reportError(reported, errorContext) === reported,
		recursive,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	const owned = runtime.reportError(
		new AsamDataFailure('response', 'host handled', hostCause),
		errorContext
	);
	record('runtime-host-owned-error-skips-on-error', {
		notified: owned.notified,
		kind: owned.kind,
		causePreserved: owned.cause === hostCause,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	const marked: AsamDataError = {
			kind: 'transform',
			message: 'already notified',
			cause: failureCause,
			notified: true,
			requestId: 999
		},
		preNotified = runtime.reportError(marked, errorContext);
	record('runtime-pre-notified-error-skips-both-hooks', {
		notified: preNotified.notified,
		kind: preNotified.kind,
		message: preNotified.message,
		requestId: preNotified.requestId,
		causePreserved: preNotified.cause === failureCause,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	const sameEpoch = runtime.createContext();
	record('runtime-epoch-wide-error-cache', {
		contextId: sameEpoch.requestId,
		sameResult: runtime.reportError(original, sameEpoch) === reported,
		requestId: reported.requestId,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	runtime.release(sameEpoch);
	runtime.release(errorContext);
	const stale = new AsamDataFailure('request', 'stale', failureCause);
	record('runtime-stale-and-foreign-error-return-original', {
		aborted: errorContext.signal.aborted,
		current: runtime.isCurrent(errorContext),
		staleIdentity: runtime.reportError(stale, errorContext) === stale,
		foreignIdentity: runtime.reportError(stale, foreign) === stale,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	runtime.invalidate();
	const nextContext = runtime.createContext(),
		fresh = runtime.reportError(original, nextContext);
	record('runtime-invalidation-clears-notification-cache', {
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		id: nextContext.requestId,
		newResult: fresh !== reported,
		requestId: fresh.requestId,
		notified: fresh.notified,
		causePreserved: fresh.cause === failureCause,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	runtime.release(nextContext);
	const noHookContext = emptyRuntime.createContext(),
		unhandled = emptyRuntime.reportError(original, noHookContext);
	record('runtime-provider-absent-error-normalization', {
		kind: unhandled.kind,
		causePreserved: unhandled.cause === failureCause,
		notified: unhandled.notified,
		requestId: unhandled.requestId,
		frozen: Object.isFrozen(unhandled),
		deduplicated: emptyRuntime.reportError(original, noHookContext) === unhandled
	});
	emptyRuntime.release(noHookContext);
	const invalidScopes = ['', ' ', 0, null].map((scope) => ({
		input: scope,
		constructor: configFailure(() =>
			Reflect.apply(createAsamDataRuntime, undefined, [{ scope }])
		),
		setter: configFailure(() => Reflect.apply(runtime.setScope, undefined, [scope]))
	}));
	record('runtime-invalid-scope-constructor-and-setter', {
		invalidScopes,
		scope: runtime.scope,
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	const invalidProviders: [string, unknown][] = [
		['null', null],
		['scalar', 'bad'],
		...['request', 'upload', 'adaptOptions', 'adaptPage', 'onError', 'isErrorNotified'].map(
			(name) => [name, { [name]: true }] as [string, unknown]
		),
		['dict-null', { dict: null }],
		['dict-get', { dict: { get: true } }],
		['dict-refresh', { dict: { get: async () => [], refresh: true } }],
		['pagination-null', { pagination: null }],
		['pagination-empty-page', { pagination: { page: ' ', pageSize: 'size' } }],
		['pagination-empty-size', { pagination: { page: 'page', pageSize: '' } }],
		['pagination-scalar', { pagination: { page: 1, pageSize: 'size' } }],
		['pagination-duplicate', { pagination: { page: 'same', pageSize: 'same' } }]
	];
	const rejectedProviders = invalidProviders.map(([name, value]) => ({
		name,
		constructor: configFailure(() =>
			Reflect.apply(createAsamDataRuntime, undefined, [{ provider: value }])
		),
		installer: configFailure(() => Reflect.apply(runtime.install, undefined, [value]))
	}));
	record('runtime-invalid-providers-preserve-installed-provider', {
		rejectedProviders,
		providerIdentity: runtime.provider === provider,
		scope: runtime.scope,
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	runtime.invalidate();
	emptyRuntime.invalidate();
	record('runtime-final-cleanup-and-zero-transport', {
		epoch: runtime.epoch,
		emptyEpoch: emptyRuntime.epoch,
		current: runtime.isCurrent(nextContext),
		aborted: nextContext.signal.aborted,
		events: [...events],
		calls: { ...calls }
	});
	runtimeContractResult.value = observations;
}

const mockContractResult = ref<{ phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[]>([]),
	mockContractRunning = ref(false);
async function runMockContract() {
	mockContractRunning.value = true;
	const observations: { phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];
	const record = (phase: string, state: Record<string, unknown>) =>
		observations.push({ phase, state });
	const rejected = async (action: () => Promise<unknown>) => {
		try {
			await action();
			throw Error('Expected mock rejection');
		} catch (cause) {
			return cause;
		}
	};
	const typedFailure = (cause: unknown) => {
		if (!(cause instanceof AsamDataFailure)) throw cause;
		return {
			kind: cause.kind,
			message: cause.message,
			causeAbsent: cause.cause === undefined,
			notified: cause.notified,
			name: cause.name,

		typeof value !== 'object' ||

			Reflect.ownKeys(value).every((key) => deeplyFrozen(Reflect.get(value, key))));

		let release = () => {},
			reject = (_cause: unknown) => {
				void _cause;
			};

			release = resolve;
			reject = fail;
		});
		return { wait, release, reject };

	const requestCause = { code: 'request-owned' },

		requestSteps: AsamMockStep<unknown>[] = [{ data: hostData }, { error: requestCause }],
		dictSteps: AsamMockStep<readonly AsamDictEntry[]>[] = [
			{ data: [{ label: 'One', value: 1, children: [{ label: 'Leaf', value: 2 }] }] },
			{ error: dictCause }
		],
		refreshSteps: AsamMockStep<void>[] = [{ data: undefined }, { error: refreshCause }];
	const options: AsamMockProviderOptions = {
			requests: { 'get /items': requestSteps, 'post /items': [{ data: 'posted' }] },
			dictionaries: { items: dictSteps },
			refresh: refreshSteps
		},
		provider: AsamMockProvider = createAsamMockProvider(options);
	if (!provider.request || !provider.dict?.refresh)
		throw Error('Configured mock methods missing');
	const request = provider.request,
		dict = provider.dict,
		refresh = provider.dict.refresh;
	requestSteps.push({ data: 'external-step' });
	dictSteps.push({ data: [] });
	refreshSteps.push({ data: undefined });
	record('mock-option-queues-copied-at-construction', {
		frozen: Object.isFrozen(provider),
		dictFrozen: Object.isFrozen(dict),
		calls: provider.calls.length,
		originalLengths: [requestSteps.length, dictSteps.length, refreshSteps.length]
	});
	const hostConfig = { url: '/items', params: { limit: 1, nested: { ids: [1] } } },
		response = await request(hostConfig, context),
		firstCalls = provider.calls,
		firstCall = firstCalls[0];
	if (!firstCall) throw Error('Mock call missing');
	hostConfig.params.limit = 2;
	hostConfig.params.nested.ids.push(2);
	hostData.value = 2;
	hostData.nested.ids.push(2);
	record('mock-default-get-request-and-deep-snapshots', {
		response,
		request: firstCall.request,
		key: firstCall.key,
		kind: firstCall.kind,
		contextIdentity: firstCall.context === context,
		callsFrozen: Object.isFrozen(firstCalls),
		callFrozen: Object.isFrozen(firstCall),
		requestFrozen: Object.isFrozen(firstCall.request),
		responseFrozen: Object.isFrozen(response),
		requestDeepFrozen: deeplyFrozen(firstCall.request),
		responseDeepFrozen: deeplyFrozen(response),
		hostConfig,
		hostData
	});
	record('mock-error-step-preserves-original-cause', {
		identity: (await rejected(() => request({ url: '/items' }, context))) === requestCause
	});
	record('mock-request-exhaustion-without-implicit-repeat', {
		failure: typedFailure(await rejected(() => request({ url: '/items' }, context)))
	});
	record('mock-explicit-method-route', {
		result: await request({ url: '/items', method: 'post' }, context),
		key: provider.calls.at(-1)?.key
	});
	record('mock-unconfigured-method-and-route', {

			await rejected(() => request({ url: '/items', method: 'put' }, context))
		),
		route: typedFailure(await rejected(() => request({ url: '/missing' }, context)))
	});
	const dictionary = await dict.get('items', context);
	record('mock-dictionary-success-and-frozen-children', {
		dictionary,
		frozen:

		deepFrozen: deeplyFrozen(dictionary),
		call: provider.calls.at(-1)?.kind,
		key: provider.calls.at(-1)?.key
	});
	record('mock-dictionary-error-step-preserves-original-cause', {
		identity: (await rejected(() => dict.get('items', context))) === dictCause
	});
	record('mock-dictionary-exhaustion', {
		failure: typedFailure(await rejected(() => dict.get('items', context)))
	});
	record('mock-refresh-success-undefined', {

		kind: provider.calls.at(-1)?.kind,
		key: provider.calls.at(-1)?.key
	});
	record('mock-refresh-error-step-preserves-original-cause', {

	record('mock-refresh-exhaustion', {
		failure: typedFailure(await rejected(() => refresh(context)))
	});

	record('mock-empty-refresh-is-configured-but-exhausted', {

		failure: typedFailure(await rejected(() => emptyRefresh.dict!.refresh!(context)))
	});
	const combinedCause = { code: 'mixed-owned' },

			}
		});
	if (!precedence.request) throw Error('Mixed request missing');
	const mixedRequest = precedence.request;
	record('mock-data-and-error-step-priority-and-undefined-cause', {
		errorWins:
			(await rejected(() => mixedRequest({ url: '/mixed' }, context))) === combinedCause,
		undefinedCausePreserved:
			(await rejected(() => mixedRequest({ url: '/mixed' }, context))) === undefined,
		calls: precedence.calls.length
	});
	const delays = gate(),
		rejection = gate(),
		abort = gate(),
		waitCause = { code: 'wait-owned' },
		gated = createAsamMockProvider({
			requests: {
				'get /gate': [{ data: 'released', wait: delays.wait }, { data: 'next' }],
				'get /reject': [{ data: 'unused', wait: rejection.wait }],
				'get /abort': [
					{ data: 'cancelled-data', wait: abort.wait },
					{ data: 'after-abort' }

				'get /pre': [{ data: 'not-consumed' }]

		});
	if (!gated.request) throw Error('Gated request missing');
	const gatedRequest = gated.request;
	let settled = false;
	const pending = gatedRequest({ url: '/gate' }, context).then((value) => {
		settled = true;
		return value;
	});
	await Promise.resolve();
	record('mock-wait-gate-pending-with-recorded-call', {
		settled,
		calls: gated.calls.length,
		key: gated.calls[0]?.key
	});
	delays.release();
	record('mock-wait-gate-release-and-next-step', {
		result: await pending,
		next: await gatedRequest({ url: '/gate' }, context),
		settled
	});
	const rejectedWait = rejected(() => gatedRequest({ url: '/reject' }, context));
	rejection.reject(waitCause);
	record('mock-wait-gate-rejection-preserves-original', {
		identity: (await rejectedWait) === waitCause
	});
	const abortContext = runtime.createContext(),
		abortedWait = rejected(() => gatedRequest({ url: '/abort' }, abortContext));
	runtime.release(abortContext);
	record('mock-wait-gate-aborts-before-release', {
		identity: (await abortedWait) === abortContext.signal.reason,

		'request',
		'response',
		'transform',
		'upload'
	];
	record('mock-public-data-failure-full-kind-contract', {

			return {

		calls: provider.calls.map((call) => ({
			kind: call.kind,
			key: call.key,
			contextId: call.context.requestId,
			contextScope: call.context.scope,
			requestPresent: call.request !== undefined,
			frozen: Object.isFrozen(call)
		})),
		firstSnapshotLength: firstCalls.length,
		currentLength: provider.calls.length,
		freshArray: provider.calls !== provider.calls,
		gatedKeys: gated.calls.map((call) => call.key),
		originalQueueLengths: [requestSteps.length, dictSteps.length, refreshSteps.length]
	});
	runtime.invalidate();
	record('mock-final-cleanup-historical-context-observes-abort', {

		gatedCalls: gated.calls.length

	mockContractRunning.value = false;
}

const normalizerContractResult = ref<{ phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[]>([]);
function runNormalizerContract() {
	const observations: { phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];
	const record = (phase: string, state: Record<string, unknown>) =>
		observations.push({ phase, state });
	const frozen = (value: unknown): boolean =>
		value === null ||
		typeof value !== 'object' ||
		(Object.isFrozen(value) &&
			Reflect.ownKeys(value).every((key) => frozen(Reflect.get(value, key))));
	const failure = (action: () => unknown) => {
		try {
			action();
			throw Error('Expected normalization rejection');
		} catch (cause) {
			if (!(cause instanceof AsamDataFailure)) throw cause;
			return {
				kind: cause.kind,
				message: cause.message,
				causeKind: cause.cause instanceof AsamDataFailure ? cause.cause.kind : null,
				causeName: cause.cause instanceof Error ? cause.cause.name : null
			};
		}
	};
	const values: AsamValue[] = [1, '1', true, false, 0, '', -2.5],
		input = values.map((value, i) => ({ label: 'Value-' + i, value })),
		options = normalizeAsamOptions(input);
	record('normalizer-default-seven-typed-identities', {
		values: options.map((o) => o.value),
		types: options.map((o) => typeof o.value),
		frozen: frozen(options),
		rawIndependent: options.every((o, i) => o.raw !== input[i]),
		empty: normalizeAsamOptions([])
	});
	const host = [
			{ label: '', value: '', disabled: undefined, children: undefined },
			{ label: 'Host', value: 2, meta: { count: 1 } }
		],
		snapshot = normalizeAsamOptions(host);
	host[1]!.meta!.count = 2;
	record('normalizer-empty-label-undefined-optionals-and-host-snapshot', {
		options: snapshot,
		hostCount: host[1]!.meta!.count,
		frozen: frozen(snapshot)
	});
	const fields: AsamMapping = {
			label: 'name.label',
			value: 'id',
			disabled: 'locked',
			children: 'nodes'
		},
		treeRules: AsamOptionRules = { tree: true },
		tree = normalizeAsamOptions(
			[
				{
					'name.label': 'Parent',
					id: 0,
					locked: false,
					nodes: [{ 'name.label': 'Leaf', id: false }]
				}
			],
			fields,
			treeRules
		);
	record('normalizer-own-dotted-field-mapping-and-tree', {
		tree,
		frozen: frozen(tree),
		flatEmptyChildren: normalizeAsamOptions([{ label: 'Leaf', value: 'leaf', children: [] }]),
		sameKeyMapping: normalizeAsamOptions([{ same: 'same' }], { label: 'same', value: 'same' })
	});
	const policies: AsamOptionRules[] = [
		{ valuePolicy: { multiple: false, valueMode: 'value' } },
		{ valuePolicy: { multiple: false, valueMode: 'object' } },
		{ valuePolicy: { multiple: true, valueMode: 'value', multipleValueMode: 'array' } },
		{ valuePolicy: { multiple: true, valueMode: 'value', multipleValueMode: 'string' } },
		{ valuePolicy: { multiple: true, valueMode: 'object', multipleValueMode: 'array' } }

			adaptPage: () => {

		adapterFailure = failure(() =>
			resolveAsamPage(envelope, undefined, {
				adaptPage: () => {
					throw adapterCause;
				}
			})

const sourceContractResult = ref<{ phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[]>([]);
const sourceContractBusy = ref(false);
async function runSourceContract() {

		const guardedApi = factory.api({

		record('source-rules-validation-before-all-remote-io', {

					rejectAsync(() =>

							current,
							{ context: context(), provider: guardedProvider, separator: '' }
						])
					)
				)
			),
			calls: guardedCalls
		});
		const transportCases: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
		for (const kind of ['api', 'request', 'dict'] as const)
			for (const mode of ['throw', 'reject', 'non-promise'] as const) {
				const original = Error(kind + '-' + mode),
					run = () => {
						if (mode === 'throw') throw original;
						return mode === 'reject' ? Promise.reject(original) : [];
					};
				const selected =
					kind === 'api'
						? Reflect.apply(factory.api, undefined, [{ api: run, params: undefined }])
						: kind === 'request'
							? requestSource
							: dictSource;
				transportCases.push({
					kind,
					mode,
					failure: await rejectAsync(
						() =>
							Reflect.apply(resolveAsamOptions, undefined, [
								selected,
								{
									context: context(),
									provider: { request: run, dict: { get: run } }
								}
							]),

			}

			for (const mode of ['throw', 'async-resolve', 'async-reject', 'malformed'] as const) {

					parse = () => {
						if (mode === 'throw') throw original;
						if (mode === 'async-reject') return Promise.reject(original);
						if (mode === 'async-resolve') return Promise.resolve([]);
						return {};
					};
				const selected = Reflect.apply(factory.api, undefined, [
					{
						api: async () => [],
						params: undefined,
						...(stage === 'transform' ? { transform: parse } : {})
					}
				]);
				stages.push({
					stage,
					mode,
					failure: await rejectAsync(
						() =>
							Reflect.apply(resolveAsamOptions, undefined, [
								selected,
								{
									context: context(),
									provider:

								}
							]),
						mode === 'throw' ? original : undefined
					)
				});
			}
		record('source-eight-transform-adapter-sync-guards-and-error-stages', { cases: stages });
		record('source-static-config-versus-remote-response-failures', {
			static: await rejectAsync(() =>
				resolveAsamOptions(factory.static({ options: [{ label: 'Bad', value: {} }] }), {
					context: context()
				})
			),
			api: await rejectAsync(() =>
				resolveAsamOptions(factory.api({ api: async () => ({}), params: undefined }), {
					context: context()
				})
			),
			dictionary: await rejectAsync(() =>
				resolveAsamOptions(
					defineAsamDictSource({ dictType: 'invalid', dictValueType: 'number' }),
					{
						context: context(),
						provider: {
							dict: { get: async () => [{ label: 'Bad', value: 'not-number' }] }
						}
					}
				)
			),
			staticConstructionRemainsLazy: factory.static({
				options: [{ label: 'Bad', value: {} }]
			}).kind
		});
		const aborted = new AbortController(),
			reason = { owned: 'pre-abort' };
		aborted.abort(reason);
		let abortedCalls = 0;
		const abortApi = factory.api({
			api: async () => {
				abortedCalls++;
				return [];
			},
			params: undefined
		});
		const preAborts: boolean[] = [];
		for (const current of [source, abortApi, requestSource, dictSource]) {
			try {
				await resolveAsamOptions(current, {
					context: context(aborted.signal),
					provider: {
						request: async () => {
							abortedCalls++;
							return [];
						},
						dict: {
							get: async () => {
								abortedCalls++;
								return [];
							}
						}
					}
				});
			} catch (cause) {
				preAborts.push(cause === reason);
			}
		}
		record('source-pre-abort-exact-reason-four-kinds-zero-io', {
			preAborts,
			calls: abortedCalls
		});
		const lateResults: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
		for (const mode of ['resolve', 'reject'] as const) {
			const controller = new AbortController(),
				abortReason = { mode },
				lateCause = Error('late-' + mode);
			let release: (value: unknown) => void = () => {
					throw Error('Missing release');
				},
				reject: (cause: unknown) => void = () => {
					throw Error('Missing rejection');
				},
				transforms = 0,
				calls = 0;
			const gated = factory.api({
				api: () => {
					calls++;
					return new Promise<unknown>((done, fail) => {
						release = done;
						reject = fail;
					});
				},
				params: undefined,
				transform: () => {
					transforms++;
					return [];
				}
			});
			const pending = resolveAsamOptions(gated, { context: context(controller.signal) }).then(
				() => false,
				(cause) => cause === abortReason
			);
			controller.abort(abortReason);
			const promptExactReason = await pending;
			if (mode === 'resolve') release([]);

			await Promise.resolve();
			await Promise.resolve();

		}
		record('source-prompt-abort-ignored-transport-and-late-settlement', { cases: lateResults });
		sourceContractResult.value = observations;
	} catch (cause) {
		sourceContractResult.value = [
			...observations,
			{
				phase: 'source-contract-unexpected-failure',
				state: { message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause) }
			}
		];
	} finally {
		sourceContractBusy.value = false;
	}

const optionsStateInjectionTarget = ref<HTMLElement>();
const optionsStateContractResult = ref<{ phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[]>([]);
const optionsStateContractBusy = ref(false);
async function runOptionsStateContract() {
	optionsStateContractBusy.value = true;
	optionsStateContractResult.value = [];
	const observations: { phase: string; state: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [],
		scopes: EffectScope[] = [];
	const record = (phase: string, state: Record<string, unknown>) =>

		config: AsamOptionsStateConfig<AsamValue, AsamRecord>,

		loading: state.loading.value,
		error: state.error.value?.kind ?? null,
		errorMessage: state.error.value?.message ?? null,
		stale: state.stale.value,

			snapshot: snapshot(current),

			).state,
			dictB = attach(
				{ source: dictInput, runtime: dictRuntime, immediate: false },
				'dict'
			).state;
		await Promise.all([dictA.reload(), dictB.reload()]);
		const beforeForce = {
			calls: dictCalls,
			refreshCalls,
			sameSnapshot: dictA.data.value === dictB.data.value
		};
		const dictForced = await Promise.all([
			dictA.reload({ force: true }),
			dictB.reload({ force: true })
		]);
		record('options-state-dictionary-sharing-and-deduplicated-force-refresh', {
			beforeForce,
			calls: dictCalls,
			refreshCalls,
			statuses: dictForced.map((r) => r.status),
			a: snapshot(dictA),
			b: snapshot(dictB),
			sameSnapshot: dictA.data.value === dictB.data.value
		});
		const unavailable = attach(
			{
				source: dictInput,
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime({ provider: { dict: { get: async () => [] } } }),
				immediate: false
			},
			'dict'
		).state;
		const noRefresh = await unavailable.reload({ force: true });
		record('options-state-dictionary-force-without-refresh-config-error', {
			status: noRefresh.status,
			snapshot: snapshot(unavailable)
		});
		const disposedGate = gate();
		let disposedCallbacks = 0;
		const disposedOwner = attach({
				source: factory.api({ api: () => disposedGate.promise, params: undefined }),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				immediate: false,
				onSuccess: () => {
					disposedCallbacks++;
				}
			}),
			disposedJob = disposedOwner.state.reload();
		disposedOwner.scope.stop();
		const disposedResult = await disposedJob;
		disposedGate.release([{ label: 'Disposed', value: 9 }]);
		await settle(() => !disposedOwner.state.loading.value);
		record('options-state-disposal-cancels-held-job-and-blocks-late-callback', {
			status: disposedResult.status,
			callbacks: disposedCallbacks,
			reloadAfterDispose: (await disposedOwner.state.reload()).status,
			snapshot: snapshot(disposedOwner.state)
		});

		const searchText = ref('first'),
			debounceMs = ref(25),
			searchCalls: string[] = [];
		let searchDone: () => void = () => {};
		const searchApi = async (params: { q: string }) => {
				searchCalls.push(params.q);
				return [{ label: params.q, value: params.q }];
			},
			searchInput = computed(() =>
				factory.api({ api: searchApi, params: { q: searchText.value } })
			),
			searchOwner = attach({
				source: searchInput,
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				searchText,
				debounceMs,
				onSuccess: () => searchDone()
			}),
			searchState = searchOwner.state;
		await settle(() => searchState.hasSucceeded.value);
		const firstSearch = snapshot(searchState),
			searchReady = new Promise<void>((done) => {
				searchDone = done;
			});
		searchText.value = 'second';
		searchText.value = 'third';
		const debouncing = snapshot(searchState),
			callsBeforeDebounce = [...searchCalls];
		await searchReady;
		const debounced = snapshot(searchState);
		debounceMs.value = 0;
		searchText.value = 'fourth';
		await settle(() => searchState.data.value[0]?.value === 'fourth');
		record('options-state-immediate-search-reactivity-default-debounce-and-zero', {
			firstSearch,
			debouncing,
			callsBeforeDebounce,
			debounced,
			final: snapshot(searchState),
			calls: searchCalls
		});
		let deadlineCalls = 0;
		const deadlineSource = factory.api({
				api: async () => {
					deadlineCalls++;
					return [{ label: 'TTL', value: deadlineCalls }];
				},
				params: undefined,
				cache: { ttlMs: 200 }
			}),
			deadlineState = attach({
				source: deadlineSource,
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				immediate: false
			}).state;
		await deadlineState.reload();
		const withinDeadline = await deadlineState.reload();
		await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 250));
		const afterDeadline = await deadlineState.reload();
		record('options-state-real-cache-ttl-hit-and-expiry', {
			calls: deadlineCalls,
			withinDeadline: withinDeadline.status === 'success' ? withinDeadline.fromCache : null,
			afterDeadline: afterDeadline.status === 'success' ? afterDeadline.fromCache : null,
			snapshot: snapshot(deadlineState),
			expiryObservation: 'real timer after documented 200ms TTL; no clock replacement'
		});
		let serialCalls = 0;
		const serialApi = async (_params: Date) => {
				void _params;
				serialCalls++;
				return [];
			},
			serialInput = new Date('2030-01-01T00:00:00Z'),
			fallbackState = attach({
				source: factory.api({ api: serialApi, params: serialInput }),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				immediate: false
			}).state;
		await fallbackState.reload();
		const strictState = attach({
				source: factory.api({
					api: serialApi,
					params: serialInput,
					cache: { ttlMs: 1000 }
				}),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				immediate: false
			}).state,
			customKeyState = attach({
				source: factory.api({
					api: serialApi,
					params: serialInput,
					cache: { ttlMs: 1000, key: (input) => String(input) }
				}),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				immediate: false
			}).state;
		await customKeyState.reload();
		record('options-state-uncached-identity-fallback-versus-cache-key-serialization', {
			calls: serialCalls,
			fallback: snapshot(fallbackState),
			strict: snapshot(strictState),
			custom: snapshot(customKeyState)
		});
		const policy = ref<AsamValuePolicy>({ multiple: false, valueMode: 'value' }),
			separator = ref('::');
		let policyCalls = 0;
		const policyState = attach({
			source: factory.api({
				api: async () => {
					policyCalls++;
					return [
						{ label: 'Numeric', value: 1 },
						{ label: 'String', value: '1' }
					];
				},
				params: undefined
			}),
			runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
			immediate: false,
			valuePolicy: policy,
			separator
		}).state;
		await policyState.reload();
		const policyBefore = snapshot(policyState);
		policy.value = { multiple: true, valueMode: 'value', multipleValueMode: 'string' };
		await policyState.reload();
		const policyRejected = snapshot(policyState);
		policy.value = { multiple: true, valueMode: 'object', multipleValueMode: 'array' };
		separator.value = '|';
		await policyState.reload();
		record('options-state-reactive-policy-separator-and-token-error-recovery', {
			before: policyBefore,
			rejected: policyRejected,
			recovered: snapshot(policyState),
			calls: policyCalls
		});

		const defaultSearch = ref('initial'),
			defaultCalls: string[] = [];
		let defaultDone: () => void = () => {};
		const defaultApi = async (input: { q: string }) => {
				defaultCalls.push(input.q);
				return [{ label: input.q, value: input.q }];
			},
			defaultState = attach({
				source: computed(() =>
					factory.api({ api: defaultApi, params: { q: defaultSearch.value } })
				),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				searchText: defaultSearch,
				onSuccess: () => defaultDone()
			}).state;
		await settle(() => defaultState.hasSucceeded.value);
		const defaultReady = new Promise<void>((done) => {
			defaultDone = done;
		});
		defaultSearch.value = 'discard';
		defaultSearch.value = 'default-latest';
		const defaultBefore = [...defaultCalls];
		await defaultReady;
		record('options-state-default-search-debounce-retains-only-latest-input', {
			before: defaultBefore,
			calls: defaultCalls,
			snapshot: snapshot(defaultState)
		});
		const suspendedActive = ref(true),
			suspendedGate = gate();
		let suspendedCallbacks = 0;
		const suspendedState = attach({
				source: factory.api({ api: () => suspendedGate.promise, params: undefined }),
				runtime: createAsamDataRuntime(),
				active: () => suspendedActive.value,
				immediate: false,
				onSuccess: () => {
					suspendedCallbacks++;
				}
			}).state,
			suspendedJob = suspendedState.reload();
		suspendedActive.value = false;
		const suspendedResult = await suspendedJob;
		suspendedGate.release([{ label: 'Suspended', value: 9 }]);
		await settle(() => !suspendedState.loading.value);
		record('options-state-active-getter-suspends-held-request-without-late-success', {
			status: suspendedResult.status,
			snapshot: snapshot(suspendedState),
			callbacks: suspendedCallbacks
		});
		let refreshFailureCalls = 0,
			refreshAttempts = 0,
			refreshNotifications = 0;
		const refreshOriginal = Error('owned dict refresh failure'),
			refreshRuntime = createAsamDataRuntime({
				provider: {
					onError: () => {
						refreshNotifications++;
					},
					dict: {
						get: async () => {
							refreshFailureCalls++;
							return [{ label: 'Refresh', value: refreshFailureCalls }];
						},
						refresh: async () => {
							refreshAttempts++;
							if (refreshAttempts === 1) throw refreshOriginal;
						}
					}
				}
			}),
			refreshSource = defineAsamDictSource({
				dictType: 'refresh-failure',
				dictValueType: 'number'
			}),
			refreshA = attach(
				{ source: refreshSource, runtime: refreshRuntime, immediate: false },
				'dict'
			).state,
			refreshB = attach(
				{ source: refreshSource, runtime: refreshRuntime, immediate: false },
				'dict'
			).state;
		await Promise.all([refreshA.reload(), refreshB.reload()]);
		const refreshRejected = await Promise.all([
				refreshA.reload({ force: true }),
				refreshB.reload({ force: true })
			]),
			rejectedA = snapshot(refreshA),
			rejectedB = snapshot(refreshB),
			sameError = refreshA.error.value === refreshB.error.value,
			originalRefreshCause = refreshA.error.value?.cause === refreshOriginal;
		await Promise.all([refreshA.reload({ force: true }), refreshB.reload({ force: true })]);
		record('options-state-dictionary-refresh-failure-shares-notification-and-recovers', {
			rejected: refreshRejected.map((r) => r.status),
			rejectedA,
			rejectedB,
			sameError,
			originalRefreshCause,
			refreshNotifications,
			calls: refreshFailureCalls,
			refreshAttempts,
			recoveredA: snapshot(refreshA),
			recoveredB: snapshot(refreshB)
		});
		const missingRuntime: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
		for (const kind of ['remote', 'dict'] as const) {
			try {
				attach(
					{
						source: factory.api({ api: async () => [], params: undefined }),
						immediate: false
					},
					kind
				);
				throw Error('Expected missing runtime');
			} catch (cause) {
				if (!(cause instanceof AsamDataFailure)) throw cause;
				missingRuntime.push({ kind, errorKind: cause.kind, message: cause.message });
			}
		}
		record('options-state-both-hooks-require-runtime-outside-a-component', {
			cases: missingRuntime
		});
		if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && optionsStateInjectionTarget.value) {
			let injected: AsamOptionsState<AsamValue, AsamRecord> | undefined,
				injectedCalls = 0;
			let mounted = false;
			const host = document.createElement('div'),
				app = createApp(
					defineComponent({
						setup() {
							injected = useAsamRemoteOptions({
								source: factory.api({
									api: async () => {
										injectedCalls++;
										return [{ label: 'Injected', value: 8 }];
									},
									params: undefined
								}),
								immediate: false
							});
							const state = injected;
							return () =>
								h(
									'output',
									{ 'data-testid': 'options-state-injected-output' },
									JSON.stringify(snapshot(state))
								);
						}
					})
				);
			optionsStateInjectionTarget.value.append(host);
			provideAsamData(app, {});
			try {
				app.mount(host);
				mounted = true;
				if (!injected) throw Error('Missing injected state');
				const noInitialRequest = injectedCalls === 0,
					before = snapshot(injected);
				await injected.reload();
				await nextTick();
				const after = snapshot(injected),
					rendered = host.querySelector('output') !== null,
					renderedSnapshot = JSON.parse(
						host.querySelector('output')?.textContent ?? '{}'
					);
				app.unmount();
				mounted = false;
				const cancelledReload = (await injected.reload()).status;
				record('options-state-mounted-app-injection-and-unmount-cleanup', {
					noInitialRequest,
					before,
					after,
					rendered,
					renderedSnapshot,
					calls: injectedCalls,
					cancelledReload
				});
			} finally {
				if (mounted) app.unmount();
				host.remove();
			}
		}
		optionsStateContractResult.value = observations;
	} catch (cause) {
		optionsStateContractResult.value = [
			...observations,
			{
				phase: 'options-state-contract-unexpected-failure',
				state: { message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause) }
			}
		];
	} finally {
		for (const scope of scopes) scope.stop();
		optionsStateContractBusy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

				<AsamFormItem

				JSON.stringify({
					model: nativeRuleModel,

					time: nativeDateFacts(nativeRuleModel.date2),
					optionCount: nativeCountOptions.length,
					events: nativeRuleEvents,
					submissions: nativeRuleSubmissions
				})

			<pre data-testid="native-rule-fields">{{ JSON.stringify(nativeRuleFields) }}</pre>

		<button type="button" @click="nativeComposition = 'size'">打开原生尺寸组合</button>

			>
				<AsamFormItem label="Activity name">

				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem label="Activity zone">
					<AsamSelect
						:model-value="sizeActivity.region"
						:options="nativeZones"
						value-mode="value"
						:multiple="false"
						:teleported="false"
						placeholder="please select your zone"
						@update:model-value="updateSizeActivity({ region: String($event ?? '') })"
					/>
				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem label="Activity time">
					<div style="display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 1rem">
						<AsamDatePicker
							value-format=""
							:model-value="sizeActivity.date1"
							type="date"
							placeholder="Pick a date"
							style="width: 100%"
							@update:model-value="updateSizeActivity({ date1: $event })"
						/>
						<span>-</span><AsamTimePicker
							value-format=""
							:model-value="sizeActivity.date2"
							placeholder="Pick a time"
							style="width: 100%"
							@update:model-value="updateSizeActivity({ date2: $event })"
						/>
					</div>
				</AsamFormItem>
				<AsamFormItem label="Activity type">
					<AsamCheckboxGroup
						:model-value="sizeActivity.type"

							v-for="kind in nativeSizeTypes"

							name="type"

				<AsamFormItem label="Resources">
					<AsamRadioGroup
						:model-value="sizeActivity.resource"
						@update:model-value="updateSizeActivity({ resource: String($event) })"
					>

					</AsamRadioGroup>

					<AsamButton type="primary" @click="submitSizeActivity">Create</AsamButton><AsamButton>Cancel</AsamButton>
				</AsamFormItem>

					time: nativeDateFacts(sizeActivity.date2),
					submissions: sizeSubmissions
				})
